_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); automaker signals, the early era

pit_profile.why: Ford Motor Company: 'We are one of the world’s largest producers of cars and trucks.' ('Our vehicle brands are Ford and Lincoln.'); among its risk factors, 'Decline in industry sales volume, particularly in the United States or Europe, due to financial crisis, recession, geo-political events, or other factors.' and 'An increase in or acceleration of market shift beyond our current planning assumptions from sales of trucks, medium- and large-sized utilities, or other more profitable vehicles, particularly in the United States.' (its own FY2010 10-K); no disruption theme in the registry is live for an automaker on this date, so the watch list is empty and the 10-K's words on the shift away from trucks and SUVs stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

classification.quality_note: Ford Motor Company: 'We are one of the world’s largest producers of cars and trucks.' ('Our vehicle brands are Ford and Lincoln.'); among its risk factors, 'Decline in industry sales volume, particularly in the United States or Europe, due to financial crisis, recession, geo-political events, or other factors.' and 'An increase in or acceleration of market shift beyond our current planning assumptions from sales of trucks, medium- and large-sized utilities, or other more profitable vehicles, particularly in the United States.' (its own FY2010 10-K); no disruption theme in the registry is live for an automaker on this date, so the watch list is empty and the 10-K's words on the shift away from trucks and SUVs stay here (the PEP obesity rule). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.30x; +13% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.76; conservative 2yr +14%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -52.6%/yr (worst year FY02-FY10 ex-FY06 ex-FY07 ex-FY08, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-5.1%/yr (Q1 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 9.4-yr ex-FY06 ex-FY07 ex-FY08 median

BULL.desc: EPS +16.6%/yr (FY02-FY10 ex-FY06 ex-FY07 ex-FY08 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +94.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY02-FY10 ex-FY06 ex-FY07 ex-FY08); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: F (retrospective, 2011-05-13) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.30x (80.1% downside to Bear $3 / +271.4% upside to Bull $56) | Adj composite 2.98 vs market 1.22: gap +1.76 [UNDERVALUED] | +13% above the EPP floor $13 (7x FY11E $1.91) | Conservative 2-yr case: +14.0% total (+7.0%/yr) | At 7.9x FY11E the 15% hurdle price $20 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; wholesale units +12.0% in Q1 2011, forward revenues +4.7% (no Q2 2011 revenue guide, Q1 2011 revenue as reported); no disruption theme is live for an automaker on this date.
